ops.text: Notwithstanding the foregoing: (i) Licensee retains all right, title and interest in and to all data, information and content submitted, transmitted or generated by or on behalf of Licensee through the Licensed Technology, including trade, order and client data ("Licensee Data"); (ii) all deliverables and work product created by Licensor specifically for Licensee, including the customization work described in Article VII(b), shall be owned by Licensee, and Licensor hereby assigns all right, title and interest in such deliverables and work product to Licensee, provided that Licensor retains ownership of its pre-existing intellectual property and hereby grants Licensee a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to any Licensor intellectual property of any kind embedded in the deliverables, whether or not within the defined term Intellectual Property Rights; and (iii) no deliverable, work product or Licensee Data shall be jointly owned by the parties.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article III sweeps the custom front end and enhancements we commission under Article VII(b) into Licensor-owned Licensed Technology and is silent on our trade, order and client data. The added carve-out gives us ownership of deliverables and work product created for us with assignment, keeps Licensor's pre-existing IP with a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to any Licensor intellectual property of any kind embedded in the deliverables, retains our rights in Licensee Data, and bars joint ownership.
proposal.summary: Add Licensee Data ownership, Licensee ownership of deliverables with assignment, an embedded-IP licence back, and no joint ownership to Article III
